page.title: Explore Technology — Pranav PT
page.description: Understand the building blocks of modern technology — AI, Apps, Automation, and Servers — explained through real-world analogies.

sections.headline: Technology has layers. Let's open them up.
sections.subheadline: Every modern system — from Instagram to ChatGPT — is built from the same core building blocks. Here's where you learn them.

sections.title: The Four Pillars of Modern Technology
sections.subtitle: Pick any pillar. Each one is self-contained and starts from zero.

cards.title: Artificial Intelligence
cards.description: What is AI really? How does it learn? Why does ChatGPT sometimes get things wrong? All of this — explained without buzzwords.

cards.title: App Development
cards.description: What happens when you tap an app? What is frontend, backend, and database — and how do they talk to each other?

cards.title: Automation
cards.description: How do systems do work without a human clicking buttons? From scheduled tasks to AI-triggered workflows.

cards.title: Servers & Infrastructure
cards.description: Where do websites live? What is a server, a cloud, a CDN? Why does your site sometimes go down?
